leaf_morphology.secondary_veins: very prominent and strongly raised, closely spaced, numerous pairs

traits.notes: Leaves arranged in a tight crown at the shoot tip with a rosette-like appearance (multiple leaves emerging from a short, central stem segment). Leaf blades are oblong to elliptic with acute tips, glossy surface, and clearly serrated margins; numerous holes present on several blades. Midrib thick and raised, with impressed lateral veins giving a quilted texture. A prominent terminal cluster of small, round structures is visible at the center, likely representing developing flowers or fruits on a short inflorescence axis.
